articles.summary:

articles.summary:
Temperatures in Hong Kong dropped to about 23 degrees Celsius (73 Fahrenheit) on Tuesday morning, the lowest so far this autumn.
According to the Hong Kong Observatory, the cooler weather was caused by a dry northeast monsoon.
“A dry northeast monsoon will bring mainly fine weather to the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be windier and slightly cooler in the morning over the region,” the forecaster said.

articles.summary:

articles.title: Russia plays down plague reports after lab worker death

Russia on Monday sought to play down reports that a laboratory technician had died of plague, even as US President Donald Trump said Washington was closely monitoring the situation and offered US help.

articles.title: US search for missing airmen in China gains new attention after Xi-Trump summit
articles.summary:
For more than eight decades, the remains of US fighter pilot Morton Sher lay unrecovered in China. A photograph of a memorial to him in a Hunan village eventually helped investigators find where his plane crashed in 1943.

articles.title: France, Germany call for new weapon allowing ‘immediate cut off’ of China from EU market
articles.summary:
In the strongest sign yet of a shifting European Union policy on China, the leaders of France and Germany have demanded a new trade weapon that would cut off access to the EU market when third countries cause severe distortions.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v Asii zůstává pod drobnohledem po amerických zákrocích proti čínské špionáži a sledování tchajwanského vedení. Paříž a Berlín zároveň tlačí na nová obchodní pravidla vůči Číně, zatímco Tchaj-wan čelí dlouhodobým plánům Pekingu na poválečnou správu.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions in Asia remain under close watch following US actions against Chinese espionage and surveillance of Taiwan's leadership. Simultaneously, Paris and Berlin are pushing for aggressive new trade defensive tools against China, while Beijing works on long-term post-reunification governance scenarios for Taiwan.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zostřenou rétoriku ohledně nových obchodních nástrojů EU proti Číně a pokračující diplomatické vyrovnávání se s bezpečnostními incidenty.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, heightened rhetoric regarding the EU's proposed trade defense tools against China and ongoing diplomatic fallout from security incidents are expected.

archive.security_status_cs: Geopolitické napětí v regionu zůstává vysoké v důsledku amerických obvinění vůči Pekingu ze sledování rodiny tchajwanského představitele a odhalení nových čínských plánů na správu Tchaj-wanu po sjednocení. Zároveň sílí ekonomický tlak Západu, když Francie a Německo požadují nástroj na okamžité odříznutí Číny od unijního trhu při systémových narušeních.
archive.security_status_en: Geopolitical tensions in the region remain elevated due to US accusations against Beijing regarding the surveillance of a Taiwanese leader's family and the emergence of detailed mainland proposals for governing Taiwan post-reunification. Concurrently, Western economic pressure is mounting as France and Germany demand a trade tool allowing an immediate cutoff of China from the EU market during systemic distortions.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat zostření rétoriky kolem navrhovaných obchodních nástrojů EU proti Číně a pokračující diplomatické reakce na americké kroky vůči čínským zpravodajským aktivitám.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, intensified rhetoric surrounding the EU's proposed trade defense tools against China and continued diplomatic reactions to US actions against Chinese intelligence operations are expected.
